body.statement: For a CNF formula with incidence-treewidth \(k\), maximum clause size \(\ell\), and a supplied incidence-tree decomposition with \(N\) nodes, the number of satisfying assignments can be computed in \(O(4^k k\ell N)\) time.

source.locator: Abstract and the incidence-treewidth dynamic program

attestation.note: The running-time statement was checked against the authors' abstract for A Fixed-Parameter Algorithm for \(\#\mathrm{SAT}\) with Parameter Incidence Treewidth.

body.justification: This is the classical unweighted incidence-treewidth counting substrate.
body.gap: The rational literal weights and all derivatives are adapted and proved in the implementation proposition.
